* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor HB mrwaltdog LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Made a few of the reccomended changes. What do you think?

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Turn One: Activate only two force and deploy a system using the objective, while at the same time look and make sure you have the docking bay, shield generators, marker 4 and general Rieekan in your reserve deck (or in your hand). If that is the case then pull the docking bay using Insurection then pull Rieekan, using Strike Planning, then deploy him at the docking bay then using Rieekan's text pull out the shield generators which then makes you pull the 4th marker.

WARNING: if you are missing any of the cards in this string then do not attempt it on the first turn. Just wait a turn. If you do part of the string then your opponent will most likely take over the docking bay or if Rieekan is there they will give him a beat down which would then shoot down a major part of the deck.

Turn Two: Activate. Use Rieekan to deploy Romas "Lock" Navander. Then go and grab two systems. One using the objective and the other using Lock's text. Now you have a choice, you can use workling to either pull A New Secret Base or Incom Corporation. Personally I would say Incom Corporation would be the best. Since you can always pull A New Secret base with Rieekan.

Turn Three: Activate. If A New Secret Base is not on the board then pull it using Rieekan and deploy it. Then use it's text to pull Echo Base Opperations and an Echo site. Then pull your last two systems using Lock and the objective. Now you can flip. Get haven out at Hoth and put Home One along with Ackbar and Thaneespi. Put X-wings at the other systems.

Turn Four: Get your Third Echo site out and then delpy Mon Mothma and another character or make sure you moved on earlier now you can deploy Echo Base Opperations.

Turns Five and on: Just drain away at all the systems you can and those you can't deloy X-wings to. Use Rebel Fleet and the objective to cancel your oppoonents force drains. Finally near the end of the game play All Wings Report in and retreive a buch of force. Just make sure you have enough force for Secret Plans.

Battles: During any space battles make sure you play Organized Assult if you have one. Hold Spiral and enough force so you can play it as a react if opponent initiates a battle.

Be sure to use It Could Be Worse and spies to help you stay alive until the objective flips.

Comments on changes: I looked into the Arcona trick but I do not like the fact that it is a react. I see to many senses around here. That would mean major force loss. Also I do not have another HCF to put in this deck that and I have TK-422 so I could not use it anyways.

Thankx for the comments
